note: pymupdf4llm 2.0 on PyPI is an empty shim; the 4llm code ships inside pymupdf 2.0 (tested as pymupdf 2.0, not 1.28.x).
product_reader: PyMuPDF 1.26.7 (product venv, unchanged, not used by T1)

docling.accelerator: cpu (fixed; recorded setting, not a quality setting)

pymupdf4llm.caption_rule: nearest 'Table N'/'Tab. N' + one of : . | text box above/below on same page, horizontal overlap, tie -> above
pymupdf4llm.footnote_rule: boxclass footnote on same page, table.y1-2 <= y0 <= table.y1+60, horizontal overlap
pymupdf4llm.layout: on (pymupdf4llm imports pymupdf.layout by default; use_layout(True))
pymupdf4llm.tables: box.table['html_tables'][*]['html'] parsed for rowspan/colspan; own header (<th>) tagging

tools.pymupdf4llm: pymupdf4llm (code inside pymupdf 2.0; pymupdf4llm 2.0 shim; pymupdf-layout 2.0; onnxruntime 1.31.1)
